title: mvh/tables/frames

t.description: time in seconds from the first sample of audio/mix.flac

description: mvh frames: one row per video frame (frame, t = time_of(frame), then one column per requested channel). Row schema after coercion (schemas.coerce_row): empty cell = null, booleans 0/1, UTF-8 without BOM, LF, header row first.
